name: facebook-clone
description: Facebook clone - Express/MongoDB API + React/Vite client

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: start "API server (8800)" cmd /k "cd server && npm run dev" & start "Web client (5173)" cmd /k "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server ci && npm --prefix client ci && npm --prefix client run build
